title: thelypteris penangiana
intro: Thelypteris penangiana, commonly known as the Penang shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Thelypteridaceae. It is native to Southeast Asia and has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits. The health benefits of Thelypteris penangiana include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects.
